{{Quote|Other arrangements are being made to rescue Simo as the Empire transfers him off of Naboo, but his personal effects are back at the small Imperial base where Simo was first being held. Go there and get the contact list.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />}}
An '''Imperial Base''' located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], some distance west of the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]], was operated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TSCL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the base was used to detain a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] by the name of [[Simo Oron]], before he was transferred off world. However, his personal effects, including a sensitive contact list, were left behind. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] tasked a group of Rebel operatives with recovering this list before it ended up being discovered by the Empire. The Rebel spacers therefore attacked the base that was defended by a contingent of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. They eventually managed to access the deepest level of the base and recovered the list.<ref name="SWG:TSCL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Base on Naboo was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TSCL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Base was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]," released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
